textos.Este grupo reclama que o filme se arrast: This group complains that the film drags on for nearly three hours and that the length is not justified, making the experience tedious and tiring.
textos.Falta de emoção e atuações apáticas: Lack of emotion and apathetic performances
textos.As reviews negativas apontam que os pers: Negative reviews point out that the characters seem robotic or indifferent, and that the emotional restraint prevents any connection with the story.
textos.Este grupo critica a estrutura narrativa: This group criticizes the narrative structure as confusing or dragging, with lengthy dialogue that adds nothing and unclear opening moments.
textos.Muitas reviews expressam decepção em rel: Many reviews express disappointment relative to the acclaim received, considering the film overrated and short of the expectations created.
textos.As reviews negativas reconhecem a bela f: Negative reviews acknowledge the beautiful cinematography and visual care, but say this does not make up for the lack of emotional engagement or a captivating narrative.
textos.Personagens pouco cativantes e retrato d: Unengaging characters and problematic gender portrayal
textos.Este grupo destaca a falta de empatia pe: This group highlights the lack of empathy for the characters and criticizes the female representation as one-dimensional or misogynistic, especially coming from a literary adaptation.
textos.Diversas reviews deste grupo consideram: Several reviews in this group consider the film too long for what it offers, with a dragging pace and scenes that could be shortened without loss.
textos.Várias pessoas do grupo destacam a belez: Several people in the group highlight the beauty of the shots, the color palette and the visual elegance, with frequent mentions of the red car as a striking element of the image.
textos.Há comentários elogiando a atuação conti: There are comments praising the protagonist's restrained performance and the cast's ability to convey emotion without exaggeration, although some did not connect with this aspect.
textos.Boa parte deste grupo relata não ter con: A good portion of this group reports not having been able to get invested in the characters' issues, even while recognizing the seriousness with which grief and melancholy are treated.
textos.Relação com a obra de Murakami e Tio Vân: Relationship with Murakami's work and Uncle Vanya
textos.Algumas reviews medianas mencionam o mat: Some middling reviews mention the source material, comparing the adaptation with the literary text and with Chekhov's play, at times valuing the dialogue between the works, at times finding the transposition confusing or excessively theatrical.
textos.Diálogos densos e excesso de exposição: Dense dialogue and excess of exposition
textos.Este grupo aponta que o filme é muito fa: This group points out that the film is very talky, with long monologues and conversations that, at certain moments, spell out feelings in a way that is not very subtle or is tiring.
textos.As reviews destacam como o filme explora: Reviews highlight how the film explores grief, guilt and the difficulty of moving on after a loss, showing characters who carry pain from the past and seek acceptance.
textos.A conexão que se desenvolve entre o dire: The connection that develops between the theater director and his driver is frequently praised, with many describing how the two recognize each other in their wounds and create a space of trust and mutual healing.
textos.A fotografia e a composição visual do fi: The film's cinematography and visual composition are highly praised, with highlights for the wide shots, the symmetry and the beauty of the landscapes, which help convey the characters' solitude and introspection.
textos.O ritmo deliberado e a longa duração são: The deliberate pace and long running time are mentioned both as a challenge and as an aspect that contributes to immersion, with many saying that time passes quickly despite the three hours.
textos.Intertextualidade com Tio Vânia e Muraka: Intertextuality with Uncle Vanya and Murakami
textos.A presença da peça Tio Vânia e a adaptaç: The presence of the play Uncle Vanya and the adaptation of Murakami's stories are seen as elements that enrich the narrative, creating parallels between art and the characters' lives.
textos.As atuações são amplamente elogiadas, as: The performances are widely praised, as is Hamaguchi's direction, which is highlighted for its sensitivity and ability to draw deep performances from the cast.

textos.Lançado em 2021 sob a direção de Ryusuke: Released in 2021 and directed by Ryusuke Hamaguchi, the drama Drive My Car follows Yusuke Kafuku two years after the death of his wife. Invited to direct a play at a theater festival in the city of Hiroshima, he meets Misaki, a reserved young woman assigned to be his driver. Sharing the daily commute, the protagonist is led to confront the mystery of his former partner who still haunts him.
textos.A experiência da obra se caracteriza por: The work's experience is characterized by a slow-paced progression over nearly three hours of running time, structured around prolonged dialogue and an atmosphere of contemplation.
textos.Os diferentes grupos concordam sobre o q: The different groups agree on what the film is and disagree fundamentally on whether it works. Among the vast majority of ratings (~87%), most emphasize the treatment of grief and guilt throughout the narrative. In this same set, a significant share highlights the bond developed between Kafuku and Misaki, while many praise the cinematography and the aesthetic rigor of the visual composition.
textos.Sob a ótica de quem se encontra numa fra: From the standpoint of those in a minimal fraction of ratings (~10%), most point to discomfort with the excessive length and slow pace of the feature. Despite this caveat, a good portion of this group stresses the merits of the cinematography and aesthetics, while some acknowledge the quality of the performances and the emotional depth.
textos.Por fim, para quem se posiciona numa fra: Finally, for those in an even smaller fraction of ratings (~3%), about half reject the slow tempo and the length of the production. Within this segment, a considerable number complain of the apparent lack of emotion and of apathetic performances, while several criticize the presence of a confusing script structured around prolonged dialogue.
